# gitmoap_group_chat_apps_slack_conversations (Data Source)

The channels the Slack app is in. A page of the public and private channels the organization's Slack app was invited to, for choosing one to subscribe. For the organization's members.

The token needs `chat_apps:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_chat_apps_slack_conversations" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The channels on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `channel_id` (String) Slack's id for the channel.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether only its members see it.
- `is_shared` (Boolean) Whether it is shared with another organization through Slack Connect.
- `name` (String) Its name, without the `#`.
